tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid tool with its price per call (USDC, Base mainnet).

tools.name: us_geocode
tools.description: [PAID $0.003 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Geocode one US street address with the U.S. Census Bureau: standardised address, lat/lon, state, county, census tract, block group, ZCTA, metro area, congressional district (official GEOIDs). No match = not charged.

tools.name: uk_postcode
tools.description: [PAID $0.002 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] UK postcode lookup (ONS Postcode Directory via postcodes.io): lat/lon, country, region, local authority, ward, parliamentary constituency, NHS ICB, police force, LSOA. Unknown postcode = not charged.

tools.name: a2a_card_check
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Fetch and validate a peer agent's A2A Agent Card (v1.0 / v0.3): fields, skills, interfaces, auth, signature, reachability. Score 0-100 + issues.

tools.name: mcp_probe
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Real MCP Streamable HTTP handshake (initialize + tools/list, no tool call): reachability, protocol version, tools, schemas, latency, OAuth metadata.

tools.name: x402_probe
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Pre-payment check of an x402 endpoint: one unpaid request, decodes the 402 offer (v1/v2): network, USDC or not, USD price, payTo, testnet, red flags.

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: [PAID $0.003 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Validate one email address without sending mail: syntax, MX, disposable, free webmail, role account, SPF/DMARC. Returns deliverable/risky/undeliverable/invalid with score.

tools.name: domain_email_health
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Audit a domain's email authentication: MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM (20 selectors), MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI and domain age. Returns an A-F grade with concrete fixes.

tools.name: evaluate_deliverable
tools.description: [PAID $0.25 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Evaluate a deliverable (text, JSON or URL) against a job spec (free text or JSON criteria): verdict pass/partial/fail, score, checked criteria, and a signed EIP-712 attestation whose digest is the ERC-8183 complete/reject reason. No funds held.

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: [PAID $0.001 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Verify an attestation token issued by evaluate_deliverable: recovers the EIP-712 signer, checks it is our evaluator, returns verdict, score, jobId and the bytes32 reason.

tools.name: eu_ready_check
tools.description: [PAID $0.12 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Before buying or selling a product in the EU: Safety Gate alerts (barcode or brand+words), GPSR manufacturer / EU responsible person on the page, seller sanctions (OFAC/UN/EU/UK) and price at the ECB rate, with a ready/review/block decision.

tools.name: fragrance_check
tools.description: [PAID $0.15 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Counterfeit-risk signals for a perfume listing: sales channel, price per ml vs indicative floor, fake-listing words, misspelled brand, seller domain trust, EU Safety Gate alerts on the brand, batch code format. low_risk/caution/high_risk.

tools.name: fx_convert
tools.description: [PAID $0.002 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Convert an amount between two currencies at the official ECB reference rate, today or any date since 1999, incl. CFA franc and Gulf pegs. Returns rate, amount, rate date.

tools.name: fx_timeseries
tools.description: [PAID $0.005 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Daily official ECB exchange rates for a currency pair over up to 366 days, with min, max, mean and % change. Useful for invoicing, hedging checks and reporting.

tools.name: fx_latest
tools.description: [PAID $0.002 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] All official ECB reference rates for any base currency on the latest or a given fixing date, including pegged currencies (XOF, XAF, AED, SAR). One call, full rate table.

tools.name: pre_purchase_check
tools.description: [PAID $0.08 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Bundle before paying: verified price/stock (schema.org), seller trust score (RDAP, TLS, DMARC, policies, phishing lists) and recall status (CPSC, openFDA, RappelConso) for a product URL, with a proceed/caution/stop decision.

tools.name: price_availability
tools.description: [PAID $0.03 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Verified price, currency, availability and seller of a product page URL from its schema.org JSON-LD / microdata / OpenGraph data. robots.txt respected; blocked or unpriced pages return 'unavailable' (not charged).

tools.name: recall_search
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Search official recall notices (CPSC, openFDA food/drug/device, RappelConso FR) by product, brand or model; filter by market and period.

tools.name: gtin_recall
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Exact recall check for one EAN/UPC/GTIN barcode (check digit validated) across RappelConso, CPSC and openFDA.

tools.name: sanctions_screen
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Screen a person or company name against OFAC SDN, UN, EU and UK sanctions lists in one call (fuzzy, aliases). Returns matches with score, list, programs, countries.

tools.name: sanctions_crypto_address
tools.description: [PAID $0.005 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Check a crypto address (BTC, ETH/EVM, TRON, LTC, XMR, SOL and more) against OFAC SDN digital currency addresses. Returns listed true/false and the sanctioned entity.

tools.name: seller_reputation
tools.description: [PAID $0.02 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Trust score 0-100 for an online store domain or URL: domain age (RDAP), HTTPS, MX/SPF/DMARC, return policy and contact, Tranco rank, phishing lists, scam patterns. Short JSON with risk, advice, red_flags, reasons.

tools.name: seo_technical_audit
tools.description: [PAID $0.02 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Technical SEO audit of a URL: HTTPS and redirects, www duplicate, canonical, noindex, title/meta/H1, viewport, hreflang, Open Graph, sitemap and robots.txt, soft 404, response time, compression, images alt, schema.org, JS-only content. Score 0-100 + ranked f

tools.name: seo_keywords_content
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] On-page keyword and content analysis: focus keyword (given or detected) placement in title/H1/meta/first 100 words/URL, density, top terms and phrases, headings outline, FAQ questions, word count, readability. Score + fixes.

tools.name: seo_internal_links
tools.description: [PAID $0.03 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Internal linking audit: crawls up to max_pages same-site pages (robots.txt respected, 30 s cap): broken internal links, orphan pages vs XML sitemap, click depth, dead ends, generic/empty anchors, internal nofollow, duplicate titles, missing meta descriptions

tools.name: seo_local_presence
tools.description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Local SEO / listings readiness from the website: phone (tel: links), postal address, e-mail, Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD (address, telephone, geo, hours, sameAs), Google Maps/Business and review-platform links, social profiles. Score + fixes.

tools.name: geo_ai_visibility
tools.description: [PAID $0.02 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] GEO audit - can ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini cite this site? AI search/user/training bots allowed in robots.txt, text readable without JavaScript, schema.org, metadata, llms.txt, sitemap, agentic-commerce signals. Score + ranked fixes.

tools.name: seo_full_audit
tools.description: [PAID $0.06 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Full SEO + GEO audit in one call: technical, keywords and content, internal links (12-page crawl), local presence and AI visibility, weighted 0-100 score and the 12 priority actions across all areas, with module details.

tools.name: verify_usdc_payment
tools.description: [PAID $0.002 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Verify a USDC payment on Base: tx succeeded, USDC sent to the expected recipient (and from the expected sender), at least min_amount, enough confirmations. Returns verdict + decoded transfers. Unknown tx = not charged.

tools.name: usdc_balance
tools.description: [PAID $0.001 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Current USDC balance of an address on Base or Base Sepolia (balanceOf on the official Circle contract).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: a2a_card_check, email_check, eu_ready_check, pre_purchase_check, seo_technical_audit · Private data: verify_attestation, seller_reputation · Public sink: email_check, domain_email_health · Destructive: fragrance_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: a2a_card_check, email_check, eu_ready_check, pre_purchase_check, seo_technical_audit · Private data: verify_attestation, seller_reputation · Public sink: email_check, domain_email_health · Destructive: fragrance_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
